description: session.rs line 288: auth_line condition includes tls_acceptor.is_some() which causes AUTH PLAIN to be advertised in EHLO on port 25 before TLS. RFC 4954 §3 says AUTH MUST NOT be advertised on cleartext MTA port. Fix: remove tls_acceptor.is_some() from auth_line condition; post-upgrade session gets is_tls=true automatically.
title: AUTH advertised on port 25 before STARTTLS: RFC 4954 violation
